name: Vermont

retake.retakeFee: An additional test fee applies for each retake

gdl.nightCurfew: No statewide night curfew for junior drivers
gdl.passengerLimits: First 3 months of junior license: drive alone unless accompanied by a licensed, unimpaired parent/guardian, driver educator, or person age 25+; second 3 months: immediate-family passengers permitted

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and date of birth (e.g. birth certificate or passport)
Proof of Vermont residency (two documents for a REAL ID)
process.realIdNotes: A REAL ID-compliant credential requires one proof of identity/date of birth, proof of SSN, and two proofs of Vermont residency. A non-compliant (standard) license is also available with fewer documents.

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 10 or more points within a 2-year period leads to suspension
facts.moveOverRule: Slow down and, when safe, move over a lane for stopped emergency, towing, and highway maintenance vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: As posted; reduced when children are present

verifyNote: Official Vermont DMV sources confirm the 20-question/16-correct test, permit age 15, current permit/license fees, BAC limits, GDL requirements, and 10-point suspension threshold. The current manual PDF resolves, but its November 2024 edition date and the locally posted school-zone rule were not independently confirmed in this review.
